title: Meeting Cassius

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: My apologies, could you help me with something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My apologies, could you help me with something?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Do you feel that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you feel that?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Is it normal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it normal?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: The air flow, air flying around everywhere. Spooky.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The air flow, air flying around everywhere. Spooky.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh thank the gods. I've only just got here and I thought there was some kind of incident. We don't get airflow like this upstairs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh thank the gods. I've only just got here and I thought there was some kind of incident. We don't get airflow like this upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Ahhh yes, it does have a name!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahhh yes, it does have a name!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: It's not really a thing upstairs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not really a thing upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: No, much higher than that. I mean UPSTAIRS upstairs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, much higher than that. I mean UPSTAIRS upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: The heavens themself! I haven't been down a gravity-well since I was a kid. Well not one with air anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The heavens themself! I haven't been down a gravity-well since I was a kid. Well not one with air anyway.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: That's right, a life spent dancing on the fingertips of humanity's reach.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right, a life spent dancing on the fingertips of humanity's reach.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: The point? How very narrow minded of you! I've seen things you wouldn't believe. A life spent dancing on the fingertips of humanity's reach. Without people like me Nivalis would be the end of the road.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The point? How very narrow minded of you! I've seen things you wouldn't believe. A life spent dancing on the fingertips of humanity's reach. Without people like me Nivalis would be the end of the road.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Are you trying to make a point about my lineage? Because I would have still got here without my family. I worked my ass off!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you trying to make a point about my lineage? Because I would have still got here without my family. I worked my ass off!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: The hollow words of a Well Dweller.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The hollow words of a Well Dweller.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Four generations later and we have a resort on every one of the settled planets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Four generations later and we have a resort on every one of the settled planets.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I merely crouch upon the shoulders of giants.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I merely crouch upon the shoulders of giants.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Rich is such a clunky word. Accurate though...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rich is such a clunky word. Accurate though...

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Privileged? Was I privileged when I got stuck fighting for my life on Candulous Six? Or when I rescued that tribe of Rock-Ramblers on Luna?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Privileged? Was I privileged when I got stuck fighting for my life on Candulous Six? Or when I rescued that tribe of Rock-Ramblers on Luna?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Space can be such a fickle mistress and alas, we are taking a short break from one another.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Space can be such a fickle mistress and alas, we are taking a short break from one another.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Family business. Nothing to worry about. Plus, thanks to this damn Unity Zone, I find myself quite stuck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Family business. Nothing to worry about. Plus, thanks to this damn Unity Zone, I find myself quite stuck!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Well...in honesty I have been struggling with something. You might be positioned to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well...in honesty I have been struggling with something. You might be positioned to help.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Have you had much experience with a conventional bio-sanitation chamber?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you had much experience with a conventional bio-sanitation chamber?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Ok, I might have to pick your brains at some point. Just having a few... teething problems.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, I might have to pick your brains at some point. Just having a few... teething problems.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh, well never mind that, the toilet thing is a little more... pressing. I might have to pick your brains next time I see you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, well never mind that, the toilet thing is a little more... pressing. I might have to pick your brains next time I see you.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh you must know of the Pierreponts? My great great great grandfather opened the very first Pierrepont bed and breakfast in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh you must know of the Pierreponts? My great great great grandfather opened the very first Pierrepont bed and breakfast in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: How about the time I had to prove myself against... you know what, there is no point in trying to explain myself to a Well-Dweller.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about the time I had to prove myself against... you know what, there is no point in trying to explain myself to a Well-Dweller.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That IS impressive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That IS impressive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Errrm, sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Errrm, sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Feel what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Feel what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The wind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The wind?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Completely normal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Completely normal.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I think he's talking about the wind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think he's talking about the wind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How have you never felt wind before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How have you never felt wind before?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How have you never felt wind before?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How have you never felt wind before?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean, "upstairs?" The Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean, "upstairs?" The Spire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you mean, "upstairs?" The Spire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you mean, "upstairs?" The Spire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Space?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Space?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow space, what an adventure!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow space, what an adventure!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I never saw the point in space travel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I never saw the point in space travel.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I never saw the point in space travel.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I never saw the point in space travel.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't space travel extremely expensive?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't space travel extremely expensive?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just feels like a waste of time to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just feels like a waste of time to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just feels like a waste of time to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just feels like a waste of time to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Family?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Family?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow that's impressive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow that's impressive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're rich?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're rich?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sound pretty privileged.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sound pretty privileged.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why are you down here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why are you down here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why are you down here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why are you down here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything I can help with?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything I can help with?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go on?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I think he's referring to a toilet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think he's referring to a toilet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean... sure...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean... sure...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, but I was asking about your family problems.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, but I was asking about your family problems.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, but I was asking about your family problems.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, but I was asking about your family problems.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't sound like any of my business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't sound like any of my business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn't sound like any of my business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn't sound like any of my business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You startled me, Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You startled me, Ava.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry.
